questions.question: Q1 What is the primary purpose of the etching process in semiconductor manufacturing?

answers.b: To selectively remove material from the wafer surface

explanations.a: Crystal growth occurs during wafer manufacturing.
explanations.b: Correct! Etching removes selected material from exposed regions of the wafer.
explanations.d: Etching removes material rather than adding it.

questions.question: Q2 What is the role of photoresist during etching?

explanations.a: Correct! Photoresist protects regions that should not be etched.
explanations.c: Plasma is generated by etching equipment.
explanations.d: The substrate already exists before etching.

questions.question: Q3 Which etching method uses liquid chemicals?

explanations.b: Correct! Wet etching relies on chemical solutions.

questions.question: Q4 Which etching method commonly uses plasma?

explanations.b: Correct! Dry etching uses reactive plasma.

questions.question: Q5 What material layer is being removed in this experiment?

explanations.a: Packaging materials are not etched here.
explanations.b: Correct! The simulation removes exposed SiO₂ regions.

questions.question: Q6 What is meant by isotropic etching?

answers.a: Material is removed equally in all directions

explanations.a: Correct! Isotropic etching attacks material in multiple directions.

questions.question: Q7 What is meant by anisotropic etching?

explanations.b: Correct! Anisotropic etching produces vertical sidewalls.
explanations.c: Profiles are formed during anisotropic etching.

questions.question: Q8 Which parameter directly affects wet etch rate in this experiment?

explanations.a: Correct! Higher concentration generally increases etch rate.

questions.question: Q9 Which parameter directly affects dry etching in this simulation?

explanations.a: Correct! RF power controls plasma intensity.
explanations.b: Wafer thickness is not the control parameter.
explanations.c: Crystal rotation belongs to crystal growth.
explanations.d: Pull rate belongs to the Czochralski process.

questions.question: Q10 Why is etching important in IC fabrication?

answers.a: To create patterns on the wafer

explanations.a: Correct! Etching transfers patterns into material layers.
explanations.b: Cooling is not the primary purpose.
explanations.d: Wafer size is fixed before fabrication.
